title: Refunds
body:
## How refunds work
If you were charged twice or cancelled within 14 days, you can ask for a refund from the Billing page. Refunds go back to the card you paid with.

## How long a refund takes
Most refunds arrive within 5 to 10 working days. Your bank may take a few more days to show it.

## Refunds on annual plans
Annual plans are refunded in full in the first 30 days, and pro rata after that.

title: Resetting your password
body:
## Reset your password
Choose Forgot password on the sign-in screen and we will email you a reset link. The link works for one hour.

## Locked out
After five wrong attempts your account is locked for 15 minutes, then you can try again.

title: Exporting your data
body:
## Export to CSV
Open Reports, choose Export, and pick CSV. Large exports are emailed to you as a download link.

## Error E1042
E1042 means the export was larger than 50 MB. Narrow the date range and export again.

title: Appearance
body:
## Dark mode
Dark mode follows your system setting. You can also choose Light or Dark under Settings, Appearance.

title: Shipping
body:
## Delivery times
Orders ship within 2 working days. Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 days after that; express delivery arrives the next day.

## Tracking a parcel
Every order gets a tracking number by email once it ships.
